verses.text: Jesus finished saying these things, then looked up to heaven and prayed: “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, so your Son may glorify you.
You gave him authority over all people, so he can give eternal life to everyone you’ve given him.
Eternal life is this: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
I brought you glory here on earth. I finished the work you gave me to do.
Now, Father, bring me into your presence and glorify me with the glory I shared with you before the world existed.
“I made your name known to the people you gave me out of the world. They were yours, and you gave them to me. They have kept your word.
Now they know that everything you gave me comes from you.
I gave them the words you gave me. They accepted them and know for sure that I came from you. They believe you sent me.
I pray for them. I’m not praying for the world, but for the people you gave me, because they belong to you.
Everything that is mine is yours, and everything that is yours is mine. I am glorified through them.
I am no longer in the world, but they are still here. I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name—the name you gave me—so they may be one, just as we are.
While I was with them, I protected them by your name. I kept safe everyone you gave me. None was lost except the one destined for destruction, so Scripture would be fulfilled.
Now I’m coming to you. I’m saying these things while I’m still in the world so they can have my joy fully within them.
I gave them your word, and the world hated them because they don’t belong to the world, just as I don’t belong to it.
I’m not asking you to take them out of the world. I’m asking you to protect them from the evil one.
They don’t belong to the world, just as I don’t belong to it.
Set them apart by the truth. Your word is truth.
You sent me into the world, and I have sent them into the world.
For their sake, I set myself apart, so they too may be set apart by the truth.
“I’m not praying only for these disciples. I’m also praying for those who will believe in me through their message,
so they may all be one. Father, just as you are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so the world will believe you sent me.
I have given them the glory you gave me, so they may be one, just as we are one—
I in them and you in me—so they may be completely united. Then the world will know you sent me and loved them just as you loved me.
Father, I want those you gave me to be with me where I am, so they can see the glory you gave me, because you loved me before the world was created.
Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I know you. These people know that you sent me.
I made your name known to them, and I’ll keep making it known, so the love you have for me may be in them, and I may be in them.”
